description: Reports whether the AI music detection is available (GET /ai-music/availability): upload size and duration limits, whether links are accepted, and the remaining daily and monthly quota with exact reset times (`quota.daily.resetsAt`, `quota.monthly.resetsAt`, epoch milliseconds, UTC). Quotas: visitor 2/day and 5/month, free account 5/day and 50/month, Premium 30/day and 300/month, shared between website, app and API keys; failures and cancellations are refunded. Call it before jj_ai_music_analyze and after a 429. Costs nothing.
name: jj_ai_music_availability
title: AI music detection: availability, limits and quota
